description: §4.12 (S445) — a `<div>`-wrapped application `<program auth="required">` holding a named worker `<program>` under another `<div>`: the application program is top-level (no `<program>`/`<page>` ancestor), the worker is nested (it has one). One top-level program → no E-PROGRAM-002; the worker carries no `auth=` → no E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH; the application's `auth=` is honoured, so no error at all.
rationale: §4.12 (S445): top-level = no `<program>` or `<page>` ancestor, whatever markup wraps it; nested = has one. §40.8: only a SECOND top-level program in one file is E-PROGRAM-002.
